info.name: Agno API Reference A2A Sessions API

params.name: type
params.description: Type of sessions to retrieve (agent, team, or workflow)

params.name: component_id
params.description: Filter sessions by component ID (agent/team/workflow ID)

params.name: user_id
params.description: Filter sessions by user ID

params.name: session_name
params.description: Filter sessions by name (partial match)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of sessions to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort sessions by

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order (asc or desc)

params.name: db_id
params.description: Database ID to query sessions from

params.name: table
params.description: The database table to use

items.docs: Retrieve paginated list of sessions with filtering and sorting options. Supports filtering by session type (agent, team, workflow), component, user, and name. Sessions represent conversation histories and execution contexts.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of session to create (agent, team, or workflow)

params.name: db_id
params.description: Database ID to create session in

items.docs: Create a new empty session with optional configuration. Useful for pre-creating sessions with specific session_state, metadata, or other properties before running any agent/team/workflow interactions. The session can later be used by providing its session_id in run requests.

params.name: user_id
params.description: User ID to scope deletion to

params.name: db_id
params.description: Database ID to use for deletion

params.name: table
params.description: Table to use for deletion

items.docs: Delete multiple sessions by their IDs in a single operation. This action cannot be undone and will permanently remove all specified sessions and their runs.

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific session including metadata, configuration, and run history. Response schema varies based on session type (agent, team, or workflow).

items.docs: Permanently delete a specific session and all its associated runs. This action cannot be undone and will remove all conversation history.

items.docs: Retrieve all runs (executions) for a specific session with optional timestamp filtering. Runs represent individual interactions or executions within a session. Response schema varies based on session type.
